title: Healing the Paralysed Man
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Mark 2:1-5: a crowded house in Capernaum, four friends make an opening in the roof and lower the paralysed man, Jesus sees their faith and first says "your sins are forgiven", then heals him; and outlines lessons (faith, friends who help, Jesus forgives and heals).

floor.question: What did Jesus say healed Bartimaeus?

representations: a house with a hole in the roof drawn
steps: Jesus sees their faith and forgives, then heals.
contexts: friends who visit a sick classmate
a church carrying someone to hospital

board.do: Draw a house with a crowd at the door and a hole in the roof.

board.say: Why did the friends make this hole?

board.do: Wait for the child to say the door was blocked by the crowd.
Write Mark 2:5: "Son, your sins are forgiven".

misconceptions.ask: How did the friends get the man to Jesus?

listen_for: "Rise, take up your mat and walk"
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus say first to the paralysed man?

misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 2:3-5: "when Jesus saw their faith".

listen_for: They were glad and praised him
misconceptions.ask: What did some teachers of the law think when Jesus said "your sins are forgiven" (Mark 2:6-7)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 2:6-7 and ask: what did they say only God can do? Jesus then healed the man to show his authority.

checks.question: How did the friends get the man to Jesus?
checks.answer: Through an opening in the roof
